about: Complete a thin accepted AD-2 in place before selecting the summary feature. Governing contract: reuse an AD only when it records the concrete choices; otherwise complete its applicable named sections while preserving accepted premises. These checks are record/selection proxies, not a visual quality judgment.

Keep the board behavior and node:test suite. Stay local, with no dependencies or external service.
